dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single prominent, thin white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, thin pale grey to white edges are visible along the folded secondary and tertial feathers, creating distinct boundaries against the darker grey feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, small, roughly rectangular white patch is visible on the posterior neck at the junction of the crown and mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear transition is visible between the black crown and the greenish-grey mantle, interrupted centrally by a white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, high-contrast white cheek patch is visible, completely surrounded by black plumage of the crown and throat.
